product_metadata.title: Anolon Smart Stack Hard Anodized Nonstick Frying Pan Set / Skillet Set - 8.5 Inch and 10 Inch, Black
features: WHAT YOU GET: Stackable nonstick skillet set from Anolon SmartStack includes an 8.5-inch and 10-inch and frying pan
HOW IT WORKS: Anolon SmartStack cookware pieces stack together to help you stay organized with nesting cookware sets that use 62% less space in the cabinet or cupboard
SLICK PERFORMANCE: This versatile frying pan features an ultra-durable nonstick surface that outlasts traditional nonstick by up 16X, so your creations glide off the pan easily for years to come.

LOCK AND LOAD: Protect your nonstick from everyday wear and tear. When Anolon SmartStack cookware pieces stack together, the patented interlocking handles prevent nonstick surfaces from scratching against each other.
TOUGH CUSTOMER: Nonstick frying pan is engineered for fast, perfectly uniform heating. Hard-anodized construction is twice as hard as stainless steel for maximum durability.
FINE FINISHES: Stackable frying pan has an easy to clean, stain-resistant nonstick exterior finish that keeps the pan looking newer, longer.
description: Stack your cookware and save cabinet space with the Anolon SmartStack Hard-Anodized 2-Piece Nesting Skillet Set. Featuring two generously sized skillets, this innovative nestable cookware set complements other items in the SmartStack collection to give you all the pieces you need in just two short stacks under 13-inches to save 62% more storage space. Patented interlocking handles keep the pans suspended to protect the nonstick surface, and all the pieces stack to help you stay organized. Durable hard-anodized aluminum construction heats quickly and evenly to avoid hotspots, and the Infinity Slide(tm) System provides optimal nonstick performance that lasts 16x longer than traditional nonstick cookware and 80x longer than typical ceramic cookware. The easy-cleaning nonstick inside and out helps keep your cookware looking newer, longer. Dishwasher safe for quick cleanup, and oven safe to 400 degrees F, Anolon SmartStack cookware features a full-cap stainless steel base that prevents warping and is suitable for all stovetops, including induction. Save cabinet space without sacrificing durability and performance with the innovative Anolon SmartStack Hard-Anodized 2-Piece Nesting Skillet Set.

details.Special Feature: Gas Stovetop Compatible, Electric Stovetop Compatible, Induction Stovetop Compatible
